posts.text: Great to join an incredible group of women leaders including two former Latina leg leaders @MelisaFranzen and @TorresRayMN. And Minnesota’s strong & proud Latino community was all out last weekend at St. Paul’s Cinco de Mayo parade!

John and I stopped by Hmong Village in Saint Paul with Mayor Her and members of Minnesota’s Hmong community. This vibrant, economically thriving hub is home to so many small businesses that power our state.

It was an incredible morning in Eagan for the Susan G. Komen Race for the Cure. John and I joined breast cancer survivors, families, and advocates who were there walking and racing to raise money for a cure. 🏃🏻‍♀️ ❤️
Beautiful evening to kick off the Fishing Opener in Stillwater!

Happy fishing opener, Minnesota! Truly one of our state’s great traditions — bringing families together and supporting local businesses across our state. Good luck to all those heading out on the water this weekend! 🎣

In Marshall, I met with local leaders, small business owners, and providers about the child care shortage. When parents can’t find care, businesses can’t find workers. We must be committed to expanding access and increasing affordability.

marshallindependent.com/news…

Stop 6 of my west central Minnesota rural tour: Litchfield! 

Everyone should try the cheese at Fieldgate Cheese store. I’ve got the jalapeño farmers’ cheese 🧀 🌶️ but there is much more! The coop has been operating for over 100 years with local dairy products!

In Willmar today: Joined local leaders including Sen. Lang at the new emergency hangar for helicopters, pilots & EMTs who save lives. I led the effort in Senate to get funding. New Life Link III facility at Willmar Airport | News |  willmarradio.com/news/ribbon…

Stop five of my western Minnesota rural economy tour: Willmar.

The intersection at Hwy 23 and CSAH 55 in Kandiyohi County has caused serious injuries and even deaths. I worked with Willmar Mayor Reese and local leaders to secure federal funding that will complete a new, safe overpass.

Stop four of my western Minnesota rural economy tour: Montevideo.

An 🍦 at Art’s Dairy Freeze! Posted on the front: Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy cows, which make milk, which makes ice cream.

And ice cream = happiness.

Stop three of my western Minnesota rural tour: Canby.

I toured the Canby Fire Station. I’ve worked together with leaders in the city and fire department to ensure our firefighters have the tools they need to keep us safe.

Stop two on my western MN rural economy tour: Lake Benton.

I was at Bolt’s Grocery, owned by Kelly & Bill Bolt. With groceries and a cafe, it is a gathering place for all.  With the fishing opener Saturday we had to check out the minnow tank! Like I said, they’ve got it all.

Stop One of my western Minnesota rural tour: Marshall! Met with the Mayor and chamber and city leadership and day care providers to discuss ideas for RURAL child care. To expand our economy we need more available child care! I’ve long supported federal efforts on this front.

Another exciting week for Minnesota sports with the Wild, Wolves, and the Frost back in the playoffs. Good luck on the ice tonight, Frost! ❄️

Video

Happy Teacher Appreciation Week to the educators who go above and beyond for our kids. My mom was a teacher and I saw firsthand the dedication it takes. Let’s thank our teachers and make sure they have the support they need.

Minnesota’s hemp industry supports farmers and small businesses, and a one-size-fits-all nationwide ban ignores the strong safety rules we have in place. I’m working across the aisle with Sen. Rand Paul to reverse the federal ban that is threatening jobs in Minnesota.

Video

Nurses in Minnesota and across the country have been on the frontlines of health care, caring for patients and supporting families through every challenge. This Nurse Appreciation Week, I am grateful for all the life-saving care and dedication you bring every day.

Minnesotans are right to have high expectations. They meet deadlines, solve problems, and plan for their families every day—our government should too.


Heartland Signal (@HeartlandSignal)

.@amyklobuchar, U.S. senator and DFL Minnesota governor candidate, says the state government has high expectations to meet given how much it has provided to the country.

"Minnesota built this nation. We brought the world everything from the pacemaker to the Post-it note. But we will not rest on our laurels o

As a former prosecutor, I know we need to root out fraud and hold people accountable. As governor, I will order a top-to-bottom audit of our state agencies, strengthen criminal penalties, and increase in-person inspections. And that’s just the start.
